en: The image shows the address side of an old German postcard. It has the printed word "Postkarte" at the top left in a decorative font, guiding where to write the recipient's address. A green 5‑Pfennig stamp of the Deutsches Reich is affixed in the upper right corner and is cancelled with a round postmark reading "BAD NAUHEIM" with the date "13.7.04" (likely 1904). The address is handwritten in German cursive and appears to be directed to a male addressee at a university's botanical institute in Heidelberg. At the bottom is preprinted text for the sender's address labeled "Wohnung (Straße und Hausnummer)".
